steps.name: loaded
steps.expr: if(document.documentElement.lang!=='ru')throw Error('lang');if(document.querySelectorAll('.qz-nofig').length)throw Error('missing figure'); if(document.body.innerText.includes('{{'))throw Error('placeholder'); if([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-fig]')].some(h=>!h.querySelector('svg')))throw Error('empty diagram');return document.querySelectorAll('.qz').length+' вопросов, '+document.querySelectorAll('svg').length+' SVG';

steps.name: morphology table
steps.expr: const data=JSON.parse(document.querySelector('#add-data').textContent).morphology;const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#normalization-table tbody tr')];if(rows.length!==data.rows.length)throw Error('missing rows');data.rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const cells=[...rows[i].querySelectorAll('td')].map(c=>c.textContent);if(cells[0]!==r.word||cells[1]!==r.stem||cells[2]!==r.lemmas.join(', '))throw Error('morphology '+r.word);});return rows.length+' строк: стемы и все леммы из вычисленного артефакта';

steps.name: document tabs and projection
steps.expr: const d=POOLING_EXAMPLE;const mean=d.mean.map((_,j)=>d.word_vectors.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+row[j],0)/d.tokens.length);if(mean.some((v,j)=>Math.abs(v-d.mean[j])>1e-6))throw Error('mean differs from Python');const projected=d.projection.bias.map((b,j)=>b+mean.reduce((sum,v,i)=>sum+v*d.projection.weight[i][j],0));if(projected.some((v,j)=>Math.abs(v-d.projection.output[j])>1e-5))throw Error('projection differs from Python');document.querySelector('#tab-projection').click();if(!document.querySelector('#pane-mean').hidden||document.querySelector('#pane-projection').hidden)throw Error('tab visibility');document.querySelector('#tab-projection').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowLeft',bubbles:true}));if(document.querySelector('#pane-mean').hidden||document.querySelector('#tab-mean').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw Error('keyboard');return 'среднее и проекция совпадают с Python; вкладки работают мышью и с клавиатуры';

steps.name: hover and focus
steps.expr: for(const scope of document.querySelectorAll('[data-link-scope]')){for(const line of scope.querySelectorAll('pre [data-f]')){line.dispatchEvent(new Event('focusin',{bubbles:true}));if(!scope.querySelector('svg [data-f="'+line.dataset.f+'"].hi')&&!scope.querySelector('.formula [data-f="'+line.dataset.f+'"].hi'))throw Error('no target '+line.dataset.f);line.dispatchEvent(new Event('focusout',{bubbles:true}));}}return 'all code links work';

steps.name: answer and persistence
steps.expr: for(const q of Object.values(QUIZ.data)){const h=document.querySelector('[data-q="'+q.key+'"]');if(q.type==='pick'||q.type==='point'){for(const o of q.opts.filter(o=>o.right))h.querySelector('[data-k="'+o.k+'"]').click();h.querySelector('.qz-check')?.click();}else if(q.type==='sort'){[...h.querySelectorAll('tr')].forEach((tr,i)=>{[...tr.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.dataset.b===q.items[i].bins[0]).click();});h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();}else if(q.type==='write'){h.querySelector('textarea').value='проверка';h.querySelector('textarea').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();}if(!h.classList.contains('done'))throw Error('not finished '+q.key);if(h.querySelector('.qz-verdict.no'))throw Error('wrong grading '+q.key);}const key='quiz:'+document.querySelector('meta[name="quiz-store"]').content;const state=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key));if(Object.values(state).filter(s=>s.done).length!==Object.keys(QUIZ.data).length)throw Error('persistence');return document.querySelector('#quiz-progress').textContent;

steps.name: reset
steps.expr: QUIZ.reset();if(document.querySelector('.qz.done'))throw Error('reset');const p=document.querySelector('.qz [data-pick]');if(p){p.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}));if(!p.closest('.qz').classList.contains('done'))throw Error('point after reset');}return 'reset and point work';

steps.name: SVG geometry
steps.expr: document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>d.open=true);const bad=[];for(const svg of document.querySelectorAll('svg')){const v=svg.viewBox.baseVal;const ts=[...svg.querySelectorAll('text')];for(let i=0;i<ts.length;i++){const t=ts[i],b=t.getBBox();if(b.x<-.5||b.y<-.5||b.x+b.width>v.width+.5||b.y+b.height>v.height+.5)bad.push('clip '+t.textContent);for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const c=ts[j].getBBox();if(b.x<c.x+c.width-1&&c.x<b.x+b.width-1&&b.y<c.y+c.height-1&&c.y<b.y+b.height-1)bad.push('overlap '+t.textContent+' / '+ts[j].textContent);}}}if(bad.length)throw Error(bad.join(' | '));return 'all SVG labels fit';

steps.name: all equation layouts
steps.expr: window.checkEquations=()=>{const failures=[];let count=0;for(const eq of document.querySelectorAll('.equation')){const m=eq.querySelector('math'),r=m.getBoundingClientRect(),p=eq.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width||!r.height)continue;count++;if(!Number.isFinite(r.width)||r.height>170)failures.push('dimensions '+m.textContent);if(r.width<=eq.clientWidth-4){if(Math.abs(r.x+r.width/2-p.x-p.width/2)>3)failures.push('not centred '+m.textContent);}else if(r.left<p.left-1||eq.scrollWidth<=eq.clientWidth)failures.push('clipped long formula '+m.textContent);const brackets=[];for(const mo of m.querySelectorAll('mo')){if(mo.textContent==='(')brackets.push(mo);if(mo.textContent===')'){const left=brackets.pop();if(!left||Math.abs(left.getBoundingClientRect().height-mo.getBoundingClientRect().height)>2)failures.push('brackets '+m.textContent);}}if(brackets.length)failures.push('unclosed brackets');for(const op of m.querySelectorAll('mo')){if(!['∑','∏'].includes(op.textContent))continue;const parent=op.parentElement;if(!['munder','munderover'].includes(parent.localName)){failures.push('operator limits '+m.textContent);continue;}const base=op.getBoundingClientRect(),lo=parent.children[1].getBoundingClientRect();if(lo.y<=base.y||Math.abs(lo.x+lo.width/2-base.x-base.width/2)>3)failures.push('lower limit '+m.textContent);if(parent.localName==='munderover'){const up=parent.children[2].getBoundingClientRect();if(up.y>=base.y||Math.abs(up.x+up.width/2-base.x-base.width/2)>3)failures.push('upper limit '+m.textContent);}}}if(document.querySelector('.formula math:not(.equation math)'))failures.push('formula mixed with prose');if(failures.length)throw Error(failures.join(' | '));return count+' equations centred, brackets and limits fit';};document.querySelector('[data-q="q-ppl-link"] .qz-check')?.click();return window.checkEquations();
